description: 해양수산부_항만시설사용정보 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 이 데이터는 해양수산부에서 항만시설 사용허가 정보(선석 및 정박지 사용순위, 사용방법 등)를 제공하기 위해 수집한 데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 항만시설사용, 정박지, 선석, 사용료, 효율화. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
